minutes.headline: Commission approved Lake Shirley weed treatment with area 36 dropped and others field-reviewed, and ordered enforcement at 70 Oak Ridge Drive.
minutes.summary: The Commission discussed public outreach to lake residents about work near the lake, then heard the Lake Shirley association's proposed herbicide treatment and approved it with changes. It continued several hearings to August 2nd, discussed 48 Oak Ridge Drive amendments, and moved forward with an enforcement order on 70 Oak Ridge Drive over a destroyed retaining wall.

public_comment.topic: A lake association representative said they prefer email and social media outreach over mailings to limit costs.
A lake association representative asked the board to approve the treatment map, excluding area 36 and with field review of areas one through four.

votes.motion: Continue the Verizon Wireless monopole request for determination to August 2nd.
Continue 58 Hemlock Drive until later in the meeting.
Accept the Lake Shirley treatment proposal with review of areas 37 and one through four (36 removed).
Continue the 22 Shady Lane request for determination to August 2nd.
Continue the 338 amended hearing to August 2nd.
Accept the relocation of the leach field at 48 Oak Ridge Drive as an accepted field change to the first amendment.
Continue the second amendment for 48 Oak Ridge Drive to August 2nd.
Move forward with an enforcement order at 70 Oak Ridge Drive.

budget_items.what_was_said: The lake association prefers email and social media over postal mailings to watch its budget.
A bond covering remediation of a road was renewed; the town can cash it in if no action is taken.
The town discussed collecting an unpaid fine and the option under newly passed state law to pull a permit.

decisions.decision: A member will ask the lake association to add an article about work near the lake to its next emailing; staff will review a tip sheet or poster.
Site visit set for Saturday the 29th for the commission to see 48 Oak Ridge Drive, generally around 8 to 10.
At 70 Oak Ridge Drive, the engineer is to return with a plan to restore the wall and grading to original conditions, and house foundation work may proceed.
A public hearing on the forestry matter is to be scheduled for the first meeting in September.
225 Sunset Lane to be added to site visits.

what_happened.line: The Commission voted to move forward with an enforcement order at 70 Oak Ridge Drive over a destroyed retaining wall; the engineer is to return with a restoration plan.
The Commission accepted the Lake Shirley association's herbicide treatment proposal with area 36 removed and areas 37 and one through four to be reviewed in the field.
The Commission accepted relocation of the leach field at 48 Oak Ridge Drive as a field change to the first amendment and continued the second amendment to August 2nd.
Hearings for 58 Hemlock Drive, 22 Shady Lane, the Verizon monopole request and the 338 amended hearing were each continued to August 2nd.
A member will ask the lake association to include an article about work near the lake in its next emailing; staff will review a tip sheet or poster.

why_it_matters: The Lake Shirley vote sets which parts of the lake are treated this season, and the enforcement order at 70 Oak Ridge Drive shows how the Commission handles work done in protected areas without approval.
Several projects, including septic work at 48 Oak Ridge Drive, remain open and will return for decisions that affect neighbors and lakefront owners.
watch_next: August 2nd: continued hearings return, including 58 Hemlock Drive, 22 Shady Lane, the Verizon monopole, the 338 amended hearing and the second amendment for 48 Oak Ridge Drive.
Saturday the 29th: site visit at 48 Oak Ridge Drive; a public hearing on the forestry matter is to be scheduled for the first meeting in September.
